swing_ideas.text: Inverted head and shoulders with potential to recapture the 50 SMA (blue) on a break out. Thin structure gap overhead is going to act as the target here. Not interested if price never gets over the 91.3 level.

Really interested in the Friday hammer that looked under the Thursday range, and then closed back inside. Also a gap fill reversal to the downside from the prior earning cycle. Looking for a higher low back over 107.5 for a look below and fail on the balance. Target would be the top end of the range up around 112.6. Not interested if the 107.5 higher low never comes.

Market internals – Bulls couldn't really get in gear especially with the Wednesday CPI rally yielding a flat result. It doesn't look like big new money selling yet, but certainly not new money buyers rushing to buy all time highs.

Market profile – We have overhead supply that is trapped and a successful departure from that value area on Friday's breakdown. Point of control right at the edge of range. Note the poor low that is in need of repair.
